questions.question: How many passenger enplanements were recorded at Denver International Airport in calendar year 2025?
questions.program: import pandas as pd; df = pd.read_excel('faa_commercial_service_enplanements_cy2025.xlsx', sheet_name='ChangeinRevenuePassengerEnplan '); df.columns = [str(c).strip() for c in df.columns]; result = int(df.loc[df['Airport Name'].str.strip() == 'Denver International', 'CY 25 Enplanements'].values[0])

questions.question: Which airport recorded more passenger boardings in calendar year 2025, Los Angeles International or Chicago O'Hare International?
questions.program: import pandas as pd; df = pd.read_excel('faa_commercial_service_enplanements_cy2025.xlsx', sheet_name='ChangeinRevenuePassengerEnplan '); df.columns = [str(c).strip() for c in df.columns]; sub = df[df['Airport Name'].isin(['Los Angeles International', "Chicago O'Hare International"])]; result = str(sub.sort_values(by='CY 25 Enplanements', ascending=False)['Airport Name'].iloc[0])

questions.question: What are the three commercial airports in Texas with the highest number of passenger boardings in calendar year 2025?
questions.program: import pandas as pd; df = pd.read_excel('faa_commercial_service_enplanements_cy2025.xlsx', sheet_name='ChangeinRevenuePassengerEnplan '); df.columns = [str(c).strip() for c in df.columns]; tx = df[(df['ST'] == 'TX') & pd.to_numeric(df['Rank'], errors='coerce').notna()]; result = tx.sort_values(by='CY 25 Enplanements', ascending=False).head(3)['Airport Name'].tolist()

questions.question: How many airports designated as large hubs are located in Florida?
questions.program: import pandas as pd; df = pd.read_excel('faa_commercial_service_enplanements_cy2025.xlsx', sheet_name='ChangeinRevenuePassengerEnplan '); df.columns = [str(c).strip() for c in df.columns]; result = int(len(df[(df['ST'] == 'FL') & (df['Hub'] == 'L')]))

questions.question: What was the total number of calendar year 2025 passenger enplanements across all large hub airports in California?
questions.program: import pandas as pd; df = pd.read_excel('faa_commercial_service_enplanements_cy2025.xlsx', sheet_name='ChangeinRevenuePassengerEnplan '); df.columns = [str(c).strip() for c in df.columns]; result = int(df[(df['ST'] == 'CA') & (df['Hub'] == 'L')]['CY 25 Enplanements'].sum())

questions.question: Did Hartsfield/Jackson Atlanta International experience an increase in passenger boardings from calendar year 2024 to 2025?
questions.program: import pandas as pd; df = pd.read_excel('faa_commercial_service_enplanements_cy2025.xlsx', sheet_name='ChangeinRevenuePassengerEnplan '); df.columns = [str(c).strip() for c in df.columns]; row = df[df['Airport Name'].str.contains('Atlanta International', na=False)].iloc[0]; result = 'yes' if row['CY 25 Enplanements'] > row['CY 24 Enplanements'] else 'no'
